description: This file contains function declarations, inline function definitions, and registry macros related to static runtime operators in PyTorch JIT, including tensor creation, operator registration, and schema checks.

classes.name: SROperatorFunctor
classes.description: Abstract struct for generating static runtime operators with a virtual Generate method.

methods.name: SROperatorFunctor::Generate
methods.description: Virtual method to generate an SROperator from a Node.

methods.name: create_empty_from
methods.description: Inline functions to create empty tensors based on various parameters.

methods.name: checkResizedDataPtr
methods.description: Checks if resizing a tensor preserves its data pointer.

methods.name: fastResizeToZero
methods.description: Resizes a tensor to zero size efficiently.

methods.name: opIsRegistered
methods.description: Checks if an operator has a registered out variant in Static Runtime.

methods.name: nativeOpIsRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a native operator is registered and can be run natively.

methods.name: canReuseInputsOutputs
methods.description: Determines if inputs and outputs can be reused for a node.

methods.name: isOptimizableContainerType
methods.description: Checks if a node's container type is optimizable.

methods.name: getOutOfPlaceOperation
methods.description: Retrieves the out-of-place SROperator for a node.

methods.name: getNativeOperation
methods.description: Retrieves the native SROperator for a node.

methods.name: hasVarArgs
methods.description: Checks if a node has variable arguments.

methods.name: PrintNode
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a node.

methods.name: LogAndDumpSchema
methods.description: Logs schema mismatch information for a node.

methods.name: sr_schema_check
methods.description: Performs a schema check on a node, always returns true.

methods.name: sr_schema_check
methods.description: Template function to check if a node matches one of multiple schemas.

methods.name: sr_schema_check_kind
methods.description: Checks if a node matches a specific schema kind.
